digest.component_or_area: ticket close STATUS event and gate completion verification
propositions: A reader cannot distinguish a close with failed completion-signature append from one closed with the gate off, because close-gate state is discarded after reading and signature loss is only returned ephemeral to the caller.

The completion_expectation enum must record at close time whether a signature was expected (required/disposition/force_bypassed/local_source/not_certifiable/gate_off/gate_unreadable/not_applicable) so a later reader can combine it with durable attestation to separate signed, signature-lost, and gate-off closes.

completion_expectation must be stamped in the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close, via txn.transition_core, to avoid additional lock acquisition that would trigger the very timeout being recorded.

_completion_precheck returns a pair (verified_result, completion_expectation) consuming the GateState tri-state, with gate state resolving first so forced closes under disabled/unreadable config record gate_off/gate_unreadable not force_bypassed.
The idea->closed transition path in close_ticket sets completion_expectation=not_applicable explicitly, since it bypasses _completion_precheck and the gate never applied.

completion_expectation is folded by _fold_close_metadata on the winning *->closed edge, declared as a present-only enum in schemas, and backward-compatible: legacy close events lacking the key reduce to state with the key absent (unknown, never guessed).
